_doc: Lexicon entries (plan area 2, items 680, 759). Key: entry id as stored in GameState.records["lexicon"]. Granted by bonus goals (battle_goals.json "lore") or by a Wayfarer's "lexicon" key after a win.

cartographers.title: The cartographers
cartographers.text: Kestra's guild draws every road of Veydal again each year. A map that is not walked goes wrong, they say, and a Wayfarer who keeps all their Spirlings standing walks it best.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.text: An art can set off a status already on its target: Ember on a Soaked foe dries it with a burst, Stone shakes off a Jolt. The battle log names every reaction it sees.

rift_mystics.title: Rift mystics
rift_mystics.text: The mystics at the Tide Rift listen to the Hush instead of fighting it. They chain reactions on purpose, one status feeding the next art.

drowned_heart.title: The Drowned Heart
drowned_heart.text: The Hush gathered at the bottom of the Tide Rift into one heavy heart. It grows with every Spirling you field, so a full team does not crush it, it only meets it.

warden_orrin.title: Orrin's cover
warden_orrin.text: Orrin knows that Tide puts out his embers. That is why Shalebat walks with him: its Stone hide and Hunker Down take the Tide arts you answer with, while Kindlop and Smoldrake build up Energy.

warden_maelis.title: Maelis's cover
warden_maelis.text: Maelis knows her tide fears Volt and Bloom. Zephlet's Gale cuts Bloom down, and Zippit holds against the Volt Spirlings you bring, so her Riptail can wait for its moment.

bench_lessons.title: Bench lessons
bench_lessons.text: Spirlings in your team that stay on the bench still watch and learn: each healthy one gets half the growth of a fighter. Only the team learns, never the storage; a knocked-out Spirling learns nothing, and a ring cap holds for the bench too. Switch it in Settings.

growth_curve.title: Growth and rings
growth_curve.text: Growth fills a Spirling's ring; each ring needs more than the last, and there is no top ring. Wayfarers give half again as much growth as wild Spirlings. Story grows a quarter faster, rematches a fifth, a Growth Charm half again, and a Spirling that is very fond of you a little more. Before Era V, a higher ring than the foe costs nothing.

bond_stats.title: Echo calls
bond_stats.text: Every bond is an echo of the wild Spirling's call. A low Vigor, a status and a calming field help it along; a charm or an Echo Shell steadies the link. The odds are never shown, only the result.

challenges.title: Challenge rules
challenges.text: Extra rules for a harder journey: One per Place, First Meeting, Spring Water Only, Shuffled Wilds and Arts, Stand Your Ground, Half Rested, Ace Up Front, Night Bonds, One Colour, Empty Pockets, Off the Books and Trust No One. Any of them combine. They are taken before the first mended Rift and can be dropped at any time; the record remembers. The shuffles follow a seed code you can share with friends.

ring_caps.title: Ring caps
ring_caps.text: On Veteran and Rift-Born your Spirlings grow only to the ring cap until the end of Act I: R12 at the start, then R15, R18, R23, R28, R32, R36, R40, R44, R50, R54, R57 and R60 as Rifts are mended. Rest springs name the cap of the moment. After Act I there is no cap.
